items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that rig-etale is a local property of arrows in WAdm^{Noeth} (source lines 4787-4897, label lemma-rig-etale-axioms). The solver must first assemble the base-change identification of the completed naive cotangent complexes from two quasi-isomorphisms, then transport an annihilation bound forward under base change and backward under faithful flatness; the descent direction is the substantive step. Allowed background: the chapter's completed NL machinery and the formal-spaces lemmas cited, delivered as navigation pointers.
